description: This file defines dependency injection providers for a Flutter application using the Provider package. It includes provider setup for authentication, Firestore, and repositories for tasks, projects, and tags, as well as an AuthState class that manages authentication state changes.

classes.name: AuthState
classes.description: Manages the authentication state by listening to auth state changes from the repository and providing read-only access to user info.

methods.name: buildGlobalProviders
methods.description: Constructs a list of providers for dependency injection, including auth, Firestore, and repositories

methods.name: AuthState._
methods.description: Private constructor initializing auth state subscription and updating internal fields upon auth state changes

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cancels the auth state subscription when the AuthState object is disposed
